description: PROFILE-ARGUMENT fixture for saga #811 (issue #816 item 6), half 1 of 2. `check()`'s answer is a function of the ACTIVE PROFILE SET, and this half pins the unwelcome half of that: asked under `core-language` alone, the checker calls the ordinary turtle program `forward 100` an `ol-unknown-command`. That false positive is the documented reason `packages/studio/src/diagnostics.ts` still defaults `semanticCheck` to `false`, which is why checker output never reaches a learner who presses Run. Its sibling `forward-clean-with-turtle-profile` runs the SAME source with `turtle-rendering` added and asserts a clean result, so the pair proves the false positive is a profile-argument mistake rather than a checker gap — and stops it being re-introduced when #817 flips that default.
